displayName: inflect work was ABANDONED — something gave up and nobody was told (#3558)

conditions.displayName: work was abandoned in the last 24h
abandonment reporting stopped — absence is not health

documentation.content:
Work on the inflect-compliance VM was ABANDONED in the last 24 hours: a row
whose retries are exhausted and whose status is terminal. Nothing will retry
it, and no screen in the product lists it.

This is NOT the same condition as "inflect scheduled work is overdue". Overdue
work is late and may still complete. Abandoned work never will.

WHY THIS EXISTS (#3558, #3573). Between 2026-06-03 and 2026-08-31, 520
notification emails were abandoned — 48.6% of every notification the product
had ever queued — all for one cause, an SMTP 550 rejecting the sender domain.
It was silent for three months. Among them were two policy-approval requests
that nobody was ever asked for; they were still sitting IN_REVIEW when this was
written, and were re-sent on 2026-10-15 after the sender was fixed. The 10
"leaver needs action" notifications in that batch were one event fanned out to
ten recipients, and the account was disabled by hand two weeks later for an
unrelated reason. Nothing in that sequence was noticed by a machine.

WHAT TO DO. The journal entry for the firing run names the type and the error,
deliberately WITHOUT the recipient — `dedupeKey` embeds the address (#3577) and
a page is read by whoever is on call:

    journalctl -u work-overdue-reporter.service -n 50

| family | means |
|---|---|
| notification_abandoned | emails given up on. Check the error first: one cause usually explains the whole batch, as a sender-domain rejection did for all 520. |
| audit_abandoned | an audit entry that will never be applied. Compliance-relevant in its own right — the queued-entry link an auditor follows does not arrive. |

THE WINDOW IS 24 HOURS AND IS BOUNDED ON PURPOSE. Production holds 512 FAILED
notification rows written off under #3573. Counting all of them would make this
alert permanently firing, which is an alert on its way to being muted. The
columns differ by table because only one of them records a transition time —
see the ABANDONED_CONTRACT comment in the reporter.

NOT COVERED: FAILED rows older than the window, and any job family that writes
no row a reporter can read, because `runJob` persists no job-run history.
